name: Material standard: ISO 128-50
summary: How materials draw in cuts, plans and facades after ISO 128-50: Lapin's built-in „ISO 128-50” standard as a pack (indicative).
description: The general section is thin 45° lines, finer as the scale gets smaller and the areas narrower; masonry of other kinds turns the lines to 135°; concrete speckled, reinforced concrete over 45° lines; insulation as loops or a fine crosshatch; narrow metal sections filled solid from 1:50. Indicative, drawn by Lapin from the general principles of the norm, not copied from it: check it against the standard your drawings must follow. Installed, it is added to the open project with „Add to this project” and applied from Manage → Drawing standards → Materials. Country: none (international); norm: ISO 128-50.

items: 34 rules (cut, plan and facade graphics by the material's name)
